title: Diffusion chain rule for the carré du champ
source_anchor: Sinho Chewi, Log-Concave Sampling (2026-08-09), Definition 2.2.13 and Eq. (2.2.14), printed p. 54 / PDF p. 65: a diffusion semigroup satisfies Gamma(phi∘f,g)=phi'(f) Gamma(f,g) for observables in the Gamma domain and smooth scalar phi. Theorem 8.3.1 later consumes exactly this mechanism.
target_statement: Introduce an explicit-domain Samplinglib interface for Chewi's carré-du-champ diffusion chain rule, including closure of the declared Gamma domain under smooth scalar composition and a direct specialization Gamma(f'∘rho,rho)=f''(rho) Gamma(rho,rho). Do not fold the generator-form equivalence Eq. (2.2.15) into this cell.
consumers: Chewi Theorem 8.3.1 abstract simultaneous f-divergence dissipation

shared_floor_audit.notes: The mechanism is general stochastic-process mathematics and belongs under StochasticProcesses rather than a Chewi-specific namespace, but current cross-route evidence does not justify declaring a route:shared cell. The source speaks about the Gamma domain; Samplinglib's carreDuChamp function itself is total, so the new interface keeps an explicit observable domain and records scalar-composition closure instead of silently treating every function as admissible. During source-fidelity review the first draft's everywhere-differentiable scalar quantifier was rejected as stronger than Chewi's smooth-phi wording; the compiled interface now requires ContDiff R top phi and uses Mathlib's deriv phi in the formula. The generator equivalent form in Eq. (2.2.15) is left for a separate theorem because Chewi marks its equivalence as Exercise 2.8 and it may require additional domain closure assumptions.
